summary: The change gates cross-document navigation view transitions on the no-preference media query while preserving the existing main opacity fallback and reduced-motion overrides.

evidence: public/styles.css:875-879 wraps `@view-transition { navigation: auto; }` in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, so reduced-motion users do not opt in and receive no navigation view transition.
public/styles.css:881-890 leaves the `main` opacity transition and `@starting-style` fallback intact for browsers without Navigation View Transitions.
public/styles.css:1130-1144 retains the reduced-motion override that reduces fallback transition and animation durations to effectively zero.
